title: 21 January 1947 — Minorities, the Common Citizen and the End of Postponement
summary: Steering Committee election, individual liberty, minority and Scheduled Caste representation, Jayakar amendment withdrawal, popular sovereignty and socialist constitutional arguments.

title: Individual liberty against excessive State power
summary: A warning that even patriotic reform can turn into force and regimentation unless constitutional design protects individual liberty.

title: A charter for the common citizen
summary: Pataskar argues that competing sectional claims must not cause constitution-makers to lose sight of common guarantees for every citizen.

title: Jayakar postponement amendment withdrawn
summary: Jayakar accepts that the Assembly granted the delay he requested; after a procedural dispute the House permits withdrawal of his amendment.
